[[File:TzTok-Jad chathead.png|left]]
'''TzTok-Jad''' is the final and most powerful TzHaar creature in the [[TzHaar Fight Cave]], appearing at wave 63. TzTok-Jad was the strongest monster in the game for almost three years. Its name can be roughly [[TzHaar language|translated]] to "Obsidian fire elemental".

Players must fight TzTok-Jad on their own, without the use of [[Summoning]] creatures or a [[dwarf multicannon]] for assistance. Players must defeat 271 other monsters before fighting Jad, resulting in a high usage of food, potions, ammunition, prayer, etc.

TzTok-Jad is strong enough to pose a danger to any inexperienced or unprepared player, regardless of their [[skills|skill]] levels or equipment.

A player may receive a task of TzHaar monsters from [[Kuradal]], with the challenge to "Upgrade" your task. Doing so will result in a task of Volcanic Creatures. With this, you can opt to kill through the Fight Cave all the way to TzTok-Jad for a special reward of 25,000 [[Slayer]] experience (not including its base reward of 1,309 experience), in addition to any experience gained during the Caves.

Likewise, a player may be assigned to kill TzTok-Jad as a [[Soul Reaper]] task. Only the Fight Cave variant will work, as Jad variants within the [[Fight Kiln]] or the [[TzekHaar Front]] will not progress the task. 

Surviving and killing TzTok-Jad is required to get a [[fire cape]] to access the [[Fight Kiln]]. Killing TzTok-Jad is also required as part of [[Kili's Knowledge VII]] achievement, as the player has to make a [[Pulsating onyx]], which can only be done by completing the Fight Caves with an [[Inert necromantic crystal]] in the player's inventory; its other variants will not count.

== Strategy ==
{{Main|TzHaar Fight Cave/Strategies#TzTok-Jad}}
TzTok-Jad uses all types of combat, except for [[Necromancy]] to engage the player, all of which can be blocked completely by switching to the correct [[protection prayers]] before the attack connects. It is critical that players know the warning signs for these attacks and switch between the protection prayers accordingly before the attack lands.

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center"
! Attack || Type || Prayer required || Description
|-
| [[File:TzTok-Jad Melee attack.gif|250px]]||Melee attack||{{plink|Deflect Melee|size=30}} <br> {{plink|Protect from Melee|size=30}} 
|Jad swipes at the player without warning using his right claw.<br>This attack is only used if the player is within melee range,<br>and Jad will not move closer to the player if they attack from outside of his melee range.
|-
|[[File:TzTok-Jad Ranged attack.gif|250px]]|| Ranged attack||{{plink|Deflect Ranged|size=30}} <br> {{plink|Protect from Ranged|size=30}}
|Jad slams down his front legs onto the ground, causing large cracks to appear in the floor,<br>and a boulder will fall from the ceiling onto the player. This cannot be avoided by moving.
|-
|[[File:TzTok-Jad Magic attack.gif|250px]]||Magic attack||{{plink|Deflect Magic|size=30}} <br> {{plink|Protect from Magic|size=30}} 
|Jad breathes fire shortly and lowers his head before raising his front feet<br>and emitting a fireball that deals Magic damage upon hitting the player.
|}

All styles of TzTok-Jad's attacks deal 50–95% of the player's maximum life points as damage. [[Monster Examine]] reports his max standard hit as 2,240.

Once TzTok-Jad is reduced to 50% health, he will summon four [[Yt-HurKot]]; who heal him repeatedly. If they successfully heal him to full health, then TzTok-Jad will call on them again—even if the previous group of healers were subsequently killed off.

==Rewards==
[[File:TzTok-Jad's death.png|thumb|TzTok-Jad's death.]]
Although TzTok-Jad does not drop any items directly, defeating it rewards the player with several items, as they will have successfully completed the [[TzHaar Fight Cave]].

===100% drops===
It is possible to not receive the fire cape if the player dies before Jad's death animation finishes. Players will still be awarded killcount unless a [[deathtouched dart]] is used, and counts towards [[Soul Reaper]] tasks.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (14 June 2011)|date=14 June 2011}}

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (25 May 2011)|date=25 May 2011}}
** TzTok Jad's ranged attack sound effect now begins as soon as the projectile is launched.
** TzTok Jad's stomping attack sound effect is now louder.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (9 November 2010)|date=9 November 2010}}

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Shattered Heart|date=3 March 2010}}

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch_Notes_(20 October 2009)|date=20 October 2009}}

==Trivia==
*In the 38th [[Postbag from the Hedge]], the [[Wise Old Man]] calculated the approximate number of [[Rooster]]s required to complete the [[TzHaar Fight Cave]] and kill TzTok-Jad at 5,308. In addition, the Wise Old Man mentions TzTok-Jad is allergic to chicken.{{CitePostbag |issue= 38|author= D*|letter= Letter 6}}
* When the player has killed TzTok-Jad, their [[Adventurer's Log]] will state "I killed TzTok-Jad, and can now claim my fire cape."
* In line with the original logic of the monsters in the Fight Caves (combat levels and life points doubled every time), TzTok-Jad should have had a combat level of 720 (Ket-Zek has a combat level of 360). However, because the hitpoint limit was 255 when TzTok-Jad was introduced, he could not have 320 hitpoints (the double of Ket-Zek's 160 hitpoints). Therefore his hitpoints were set at 250, which resulted in a combat level of 702, instead of 720. With the Evolution of Combat update, the life points of monsters in Fight Caves have since been changed; however, original combat levels remain.
* As of [[1 February]] [[2018]], the highest kill count for this boss was 7,614 kills, shared between this boss and [[TokHaar-Jad]].{{CiteReddit|author=Mod Shauny|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/runescape/comments/7uqej0/top_10_killers_per_boss/|title=Top 10 killers per Boss|quote=Here are the top 10 kills for each Boss in RuneScape, be aware that we've not listed display names for privacy purposes however if you wish to brag about one number being yours then we won't stop you!|date=2 February 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/102945|archivedate=25 January 2019|notes=|name=}}
** This had increased to 7,789 by [[13 December]] 2018.{{CiteReddit|author=Mod Shauny|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/runescape/comments/adugze/top_20_boss_killers_by_monster_data_13th_december/|title=Top 20 Boss Killers by Monster (Data: 13th December 2018)|quote=[link to a spreadsheet]|date=8 January 2019|archiveurl=http://archive.is/ycOt4|archivedate=28 February 2020|notes=|name=}}
* According to the ''Monsters of Gielinor'' infographic and [[RuneScape Top Trumps]], TzTok-Jad is 11 metres tall. However, the same infographic shows the player character standing at nearly a third of TzTok-Jad's height (an average person is less than two metres tall, less than a fifth of TzTok-Jad's stated height), making the accuracy of the statement dubious.
* Between itself, [[TokHaar-Jad]] and [[TzekHaar-Jad]], TzTok-Jad is the only version of Jad that:
** Summons [[Yt-HurKot]] at half lifepoints to heal itself.
** Is not susceptible to the passive effect of the [[hexhunter bow]] or any other weapon.
